unknown_obligation_sample.selection: 15 distinct files covering all six mechanism values present in the UNKNOWN set (X509_VERIFY_POLICY, EVP_PKEY_PROVIDER, RAND_CMS_STORE_KEYFMT, BIO, C_ABI_CONTRACT, and the unmapped engine callback) and all seven file subclasses

classes.a: missing proof: the operation is safe as written, but the evidence is not recorded
classes.b: contract-bounded interface: intentionally unsafe with the external contract stated
classes.c: actual unsafe implementation defect: the reachable interface can cause UB

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn x509_free_void(p: *mut c_void) { X509_free(p.cast()) }
entries.source_assertion: doc comment: the `void (*)(void *)` shape for X509_free; SAFETY: `p` is an X509 per the stack's element type
entries.rationale: Intentionally unsafe at the OPENSSL_sk_pop_free freefunc boundary; the caller establishes the element type. Registered only on stacks whose elements are X509 (:1204, :1579). No caller precondition reaches the Rust interior. Missing: failure-injection control and a site receipt; no defect evidence.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn engine_list_cleanup() { ENGINE_LIST_HEAD.load(Acquire); ENGINE_remove(head) }
entries.source_assertion: zero arguments; only the module's AtomicPtr static and an in-repo callback registration
entries.rationale: No caller-facing precondition: the unsafe marker encodes the EngineCleanupCb function-pointer type, not an obligation (the same conclusion engine-callback-discharge.json reaches for the nine siblings). The operation is not shown unsound; the evidence (site enumeration, lock/publication argument, admitted receipt) is not recorded. No defect found.

No caller-facing precondition. A full adjudication exists in engine-callback-discharge.json but is off-instrument and bound to S=7b546f64; the registry override is keyed to line 56, not the V1 line 55, so the instrument reports UNKNOWN_MECHANISM/UNKNOWN_OBLIGATION. Missing proof, not a defect.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe fn rc2_magic_to_meth(i: c_int) -> c_int { match i { ... _ => { raise_site(..); 0 } } }
entries.source_assertion: scalar argument only; the single unsafe call is raise_site(&'static ErrSite)
entries.rationale: The function reads one integer and calls raise_site, whose contract is a compile-time-constant ErrSite (src/runtime/err.rs:1170-1172). There is no pointer, alias, init or lifetime precondition; the `unsafe` marker is vestigial. Missing: adjudication and the marker decision. No defect found.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn md4_init(ctx) -> c_int { MD4_Init(md_data(ctx).cast::<Md4Ctx>()) }
entries.source_assertion: no guard on ctx->md_data; exported through EVP_MD_meth_get_init
entries.rationale: ACTUAL DEFECT (STOP). md_data(ctx) reads (*ctx).md_data, which is NULL for a fresh EVP_MD_CTX_new(); MD4_Init writes 16+ bytes through it (src/digest/md4.rs:172-181). The exported getter hands the callback to any C caller and its documented contract does not establish md_data. This is exactly D-LEGACY-MD-INIT-MD-DATA-1, already recognised as STOP-class and fixed for md5/sha1/mdc2/sha3/sm3/blake2. Measured: court/triage/probe.candidate exits 139 for md4 (and ripemd160, whirlpool), while md5/sha1 return 0. Minimal blocking evidence: the candidate SIGSEGV; the fix shape is init_md_data as in src/evp/legacy_md5.rs:79.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe fn raise_fixed(site: &ErrSite, msg: &str) { buf.push(0); raise_site_data(site, buf.as_ptr()) }
entries.source_assertion: borrowed &ErrSite/&str; the Vec is local and NUL-terminated before the call
entries.rationale: No caller supply of a raw pointer, extent or lifetime; the only unsafe call is inside the function over its own buffer. The v1l receipt recorded the same shape. Missing: a site receipt and the marker decision. No defect found; the only caller is the unsupported-evp_type arm of ossl_ml_kem_key_new.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn ed25519_sigalg_query_key_types() -> *mut *const c_char { KEYTYPES.0.as_ptr().cast_mut() }
entries.source_assertion: no arguments; returns a pointer into a private 'static array of static literals
entries.rationale: No caller precondition and no unsafe operation beyond forming the pointer; the unsafe marker is vestigial. Missing: site receipt and marker decision. No defect found.

entries.source_assertion: all three arguments unused; the filter is read-only
entries.rationale: No caller precondition; the body is a constant. The file carries #[allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)] instead of a contract. Missing: site receipt and marker decision. No defect found.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn slh_adrs_set_layer_address(adrs: *mut u8, layer_addr: u32) { store_u32_be(adrs.add(16), layer_addr) }
entries.source_assertion: SAFETY: the ADRS is writable for its own size; callers hold an owned SLH_ADRS_SIZE buffer
entries.rationale: Intentionally unsafe at an internal dispatch-table boundary; the buffer extent/liveness is stated per site and established by the module's own ADRS owner. Missing: caller-closure enumeration and an admitted receipt; no defect evidence.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn slh_hmsg_shake(ctx, r, pk_seed, pk_root, msg, msg_len, out, out_len) -> c_int
entries.source_assertion: reads (*ctx).key->params and the input/output buffers; the table is selected by the key's own hash-function pointer
entries.rationale: Intentionally unsafe at the SlhHashFunc table boundary; the pointer preconditions are the caller's (key, message and output extents) and are stated only per call. Missing: a caller-closure audit and an admitted receipt. No defect established by this sample.
No unsafe operation and no caller precondition; the marker is vestigial. Missing: site receipt and marker decision. No defect found.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn i2r_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES_CHOICE(method, a, out, indent) { (*a).type_; (*a).choice; BIO_printf(out, ...) }
entries.source_assertion: per-call SAFETY comments assert `a` is a live OSSL_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES_CHOICE and `out` a live BIO
entries.rationale: The body reads a decoded extension value and prints it. The i2r slot contract is NOT documented at the X509V3ExtI3r type alias (only i2s is, at v3_lib.rs:105-131), so the precondition is asserted per call rather than established by a recorded caller closure. Missing proof, not a defect: no sample evidence that the decoded value's type is wrong.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn i2r_certpol(method, pol, out, indent) { OPENSSL_sk_num(pol); ... }
entries.source_assertion: per-call SAFETY comment: `pol` is a live STACK_OF(POLICYINFO); `out` is live
entries.rationale: Same shape as v3_aaa: the i2r callback reads the decoded extension value; the slot contract is not documented at the type alias and no admitted receipt enumerates the callers. Missing proof, not a defect.

entries.unsafe_op: unsafe extern "C" fn utf8_i2s(meth, value) -> *mut c_char { i2s_ASN1_UTF8STRING(...) }
entries.source_assertion: i2s ownership/allocator contract documented at src/x509/v3_lib.rs:105-131 for X509V3ExtI2s
entries.rationale: Intentionally unsafe at the X509V3_EXT_METHOD i2s boundary, and this is the one slot family whose contract IS documented at the type. Missing: a site-enumerating receipt and caller enumeration; no defect evidence.
No unsafe operation and no caller precondition; the marker is vestigial. Missing: site receipt and marker decision. No defect found.

what_would_clear_the_three_obligation_re: MISSING_BOUNDARY_RECEIPT: an admitted boundary/site receipt (or a corrected generator run) for each of the 46, with per-site contract evidence; only a scoped SAFETY_DISCHARGED entry naming the exact line can then discharge an obligation.
UNKNOWN_MECHANISM: correct the nine state.json override coordinates to the V1 inventory lines; then the sites become BLOCKED under C_ABI_CONTRACT and the refusal disappears.

UNKNOWN_OBLIGATION: the 118 receiptless files need the first item; src/engine/tb_asnmth.rs:72 needs the second. Both transitions end at BLOCKED or DISCHARGED only with the §7 evidence, never by reclassification.

probe.purpose: confirm whether the three unfixed legacy initialisers reproduce the D-LEGACY-MD-INIT-MD-DATA-1 NULL write on the admitted candidate
probe.method: one digest per process; EVP_MD_meth_get_init(md) handed a fresh EVP_MD_CTX_new() (md_data == NULL); exit status observed, core dumps disabled
probe.reading: The authority faults on all five (its documented UB). The candidate has already been corrected for md5 and sha1 (they refuse) but still faults for md4, ripemd160 and whirlpool through the same exported getter. That is an unrepaired instance of an already-recognised STOP-class defect, not a missing receipt.
